title: Tone/Attitude and Mood — Tone of Writer and Mood of Reader
skills: distinguish a writer's tone from a reader's mood
identify attitude through diction and stylistic choices
analyze how language creates emotional effects
support interpretations of tone and mood with textual evidence
alignment_note: Explains the relationship between a writer's tone or attitude and the mood experienced by the reader. Supports close reading, analysis of diction and author's craft, emotional interpretation, and evidence-based discussion across high school English courses.
